summary: The PR introduces a critical layout bug in page.tsx where the main element lost its 'relative' positioning class, breaking absolutely positioned children (background gradients, navigation). Debug logging was also left in multiple production files.

accepted.title: Main element missing 'relative' class breaks absolute positioning
accepted.message: The main element had 'relative' class removed (line 57), but it contains absolutely positioned children: two background gradient divs (lines 59-60) and ReelNavigation wrapper (line 91). Without 'relative' on the parent, these will position relative to the nearest positioned ancestor (likely body/html), causing severe layout breakage. The background blurs and navigation will appear in wrong positions.
accepted.suggestion: Add 'relative' back to main className: "relative h-screen w-full bg-[#060812] overflow-hidden"

accepted.title: Test file with debug logging committed
accepted.message: A new file testing.ts was added containing only console.log("apple"). This appears to be accidental test/debug code that should not be in the repository.

accepted.title: Debug console.log left in proxy middleware
accepted.message: A console.log statement was added to the proxy function which runs on every request. This will create excessive logging in production and may leak request URLs to logs.

accepted.title: Debug console.log left in production component
accepted.message: A console.log statement with timestamp was added to the Home component render path. This will spam the console on every render and should be removed before production.
